items.criterion: Each quotation line stores the configured option names exactly as sent.
items.judgment: Read the quotation_item rows for a known submission and compare every option column.

items.criterion: The quotation confirmation email lists every configured line.
items.judgment: Read the delivered message for the submitting address and find each line.

items.criterion: A repeated submission with one idempotency key creates one lead.
items.judgment: Count leads for the address after a replay.

items.criterion: An editor is denied enquiry contents at the API.
items.judgment: Call the enquiry list and detail as the editor and read the status codes.

items.criterion: Facets combine as a conjunction across groups.
items.judgment: Request the product list with two facet groups and count the results.

items.criterion: An unknown or exhausted download token answers not found.
items.judgment: Redeem an unknown token and read the status code.

items.criterion: A confirmed subscriber carries a confirmation time and no confirm token.
items.judgment: Follow the emailed link and read the subscriber row.

items.criterion: The product page reads as a rendered object beside a working specification.
items.judgment: A person inspects the product page layout.

items.criterion: The quotation flow keeps the wishlist visible above the contact fields.
items.judgment: A person opens the quotation modal.
